hydroglow-masks.name: Kaiteki® HydroGlow Masks
hydroglow-masks.summary: A hydrating sheet mask packed with concentrated hyaluronic acid and vitamin C (L-ascorbic acid) for an instant boost of moisture and radiance between clinic visits.

intense-hydration-cream.name: Kaiteki Intense Hydration Cream
intense-hydration-cream.summary: A rich moisturiser powered by ceramides, hyaluronic acid and centella for long-lasting hydration, formulated for sensitive, dehydrated skin.

acne-spot-serum.name: Kaiteki® Acne Spot Serum
acne-spot-serum.summary: A lightweight targeted serum with salicylic acid, made for dabbing directly onto individual blemishes as a quick fix.

ultra-soothing-face-mist.name: Kaiteki® Ultra Soothing Face Mist
ultra-soothing-face-mist.summary: A refreshing facial mist enriched with collagen, peptides and aloe vera to rehydrate and soothe skin any time of day.

ultra-nourishing-body-lotion.name: Kaiteki® Ultra Nourishing Body Lotion
ultra-nourishing-body-lotion.summary: An everyday body lotion infused with nourishing botanical oils to hydrate and support the skin barrier from neck to toe.

ultra-soothing-cleansing-gel.name: Kaiteki® Ultra Soothing Cleansing Gel
ultra-soothing-cleansing-gel.summary: A gentle gel cleanser with chamomile and cucumber extract that lifts make-up and impurities without stripping the skin, leaving it soft and comfortable.

ultra-hydrating-serum.name: Kaiteki® Ultra Hydrating Serum
ultra-hydrating-serum.summary: A concentrated serum pairing pure hyaluronic acid with vitamin B5 for a serious moisture boost, layered under your moisturiser as part of a simple daily routine.

hydro-boost-moisturiser.name: Kaiteki® Hydro Boost Moisturiser
hydro-boost-moisturiser.summary: An ultra-light, non-comedogenic gel-cream with ceramides and tea tree oil. Formulated for daily hydration and to help with the look of pores, fine lines, uneven tone and redness.

pore-refining-essence.name: Kaiteki® Pore Refining Essence
pore-refining-essence.summary: A gentle exfoliating essence with mild lactic and glycolic acids that helps unclog pores and smooth texture for a brighter-looking complexion.

doubleblock-uv-sunscreen.name: Kaiteki® DoubleBlock UV Sunscreen
doubleblock-uv-sunscreen.summary: A broad-spectrum SPF 50 facial sunscreen with octocrylene that shields against UVA and UVB rays while keeping skin moisturised, finishing light and matte.

heliocare-d-plus.name: Heliocare D Plus
heliocare-d-plus.summary: Oral capsules that support your skin's sun defence from within, designed to be used together with, not as a replacement for, a topical sunscreen.
highlights: Use alongside topical sunscreen (not a replacement)
Also helps against screen blue light

heliocare-luminance.name: Heliocare Luminance
heliocare-luminance.summary: A daily oral supplement with glutathione, rosemary extract and nicotinamide, supporting protection against UV, visible light and pollution for a more even, radiant-looking complexion.

clinisept-skin.name: Clinisept+ Skin
clinisept-skin.summary: A skin-neutral pH antimicrobial cleanser used to prepare skin and support recovery after aesthetic treatments, helping calm redness on sensitive, irritated skin.

lucent-prime.name: Lucent® Prime Oral Skinbooster
lucent-prime.summary: A daily berry-flavoured botanical powder combining skin-focused antioxidants, ceramides and a probiotic, designed to be taken alongside your in-clinic treatments as part of a skin-health routine from within.

stanmna.name: STANMNA™
stanmna.summary: A plant-based drink-mix sachet built around NMN, CoQ10 and PQQ, formulated to support cellular energy, endurance and recovery for people who train regularly.
highlights: Mix one sachet into 250 ml water, or take directly
Take 30 min before training, or each morning
No added preservatives or artificial colours
